title: Rewind from a message
summary: Choose whether to restore files, rewind provider history, and return the selected prompt to a preserved composer for manual editing and sending.

sources.text: Let's do that, then. Scope and plan the implementation. Show me UI mocks as required
Choose Revert and keep changes or Revert files too.
sources.attribution: T3 Code flow discussed in conversation

claims.text: Choose what to rewind before making changes.
claims.detail: The message action opens a pane-local confirmation anchored to the action. Conversation rewind is always explicit; file restoration is offered only when every affected root is an eligible worktree and no other Grove session or known agent owns an overlapping path. Revalidate at confirmation and immediately before mutation. External processes cannot be reliably discovered; state that limitation. Cancel leaves everything untouched.

children.text: This message and all later replies will be removed from the conversation. The message returns to the composer.
Restoring files also removes later changes you made in these worktrees.
Explain unavailable rewind or file restoration.
children.detail: Separate provider-anchor eligibility from workspace-checkpoint eligibility. A missing snapshot, non-Git project, shared root, or unsupported repository should not block conversation-only rewind when the provider can safely rewind. Explain the actual reason. Do not promise per-message rewind for steered messages until a provider boundary can represent it.

children.text: File restoration unavailable: another session uses this worktree. You can still rewind the conversation and keep the files.

claims.text: Return the selected prompt to the composer without sending it.
claims.detail: Preserve the selected text, attachments and reference semantics; retain any unrelated composer draft, images and reference separately. After successful rewind focus the restored prompt; only a later explicit Send starts a new turn. Survive navigation and restart. Repeated rewinds and provider switches retain correct identity.

children.text: Saved draft · Your existing draft and attachments are safe.  Restore draft
Please update the navigation to use the new layout.

decisions.prompt: How should an existing composer draft be preserved when a message is restored?

options.label: Keep a separate draft (Recommended)
options.description: Restore the selected prompt in the composer and show a separate recoverable draft with its attachments and reference.

options.label: Combine the text
options.description: Place the existing draft above the restored prompt; define how attachments and references combine.

claims.text: Keep conversation and workspace consistent through failures.
claims.detail: Journal the target identity, restore choice, original composer, selected prompt and recovery snapshot before mutation. Revalidate provider and root ownership. On confirmed rejection restore files from recovery and retain the prompt; on uncertain Codex delivery reconcile provider history before any retry. Claude forks must be confirmed before committing the new session and preserve a reconnectable original. Retain journal and block unsafe retries if recovery is uncertain. Do not claim external side effects are reversible.

children.text: Use each provider’s supported history boundary.
children.detail: Codex uses thread/revert with the exact turn identity and reconciles paginated history on uncertain delivery. Claude creates a fork at a validated prior assistant anchor, including first-message and repeated-fork cases. Verify live protocol behavior, rather than assuming identical semantics or treating initialization alone as proof of preserved history.

claims.text: Verify the flow in both providers and the native view.
claims.detail: Exercise first and middle turns, attachments and existing drafts, repeated rewinds, interrupted/steered turns, reconnects, provider rejection, uncertain delivery, failed restore and shared or unsupported roots. Check original and restored file contents, provider history and Grove transcript together. Run live Codex and Claude checks separately; report unsupported or untested cases. Inspect source-attached confirmation, keyboard focus, narrow widths and relevant themes in the native app. Update DESIGN.md for the approved interaction change and run project checks and install once after final code changes. Commit to the current branch; no separate PR.

children.text: Native UI · confirmation, composer, focus and narrow width

claims.text: Keep the first version focused on safe rewind.
claims.detail: Reuse existing provider and checkpoint machinery where its contracts hold. Do not attempt to reverse commits, ignored files, external actions, provider memory, or changes outside eligible roots. Preserve all existing unrelated edits and untracked artifacts. Exact changed-file counts will be established during implementation.

scope: Conversation rewind with optional workspace restoration
Durable prompt and independent draft preservation
